purpose: Part 3/4 of verified dynamic 100-record item effect batch 011; together these files contain exactly 100 self-contained reviewed records.

items/crossbow-repeating-heavy-576.name: Crossbow, repeating heavy
items/crossbow-repeating-heavy-576.effectSummary: The heavy repeating crossbow holds five bolts. Pulling its lever reloads it as a free action while bolts remain; inserting a new five-bolt case is a full-round action that provokes. Firing can be one-handed, but operating the lever or loading a new case requires two hands.

items/crossbow-repeating-light-577.name: Crossbow, repeating light
items/crossbow-repeating-light-577.effectSummary: The light repeating crossbow holds five bolts. Pulling its lever reloads it as a free action while bolts remain; inserting a new five-bolt case is a full-round action that provokes. Firing can be one-handed, but operating the lever or loading a new case requires two hands.

items/rod-enemy-detection-196.name: Rod of Enemy Detection
items/rod-enemy-detection-196.effectSummary: The rod indicates hostile creatures within 60 feet regardless of invisibility, etherealness, hiding, or disguise. Concentrating for a full round pinpoints the nearest enemy and gives the number in range; it works three times per day for up to 10 minutes per use.

items/gate-compass.name: Gate Compass
items/gate-compass.effectSummary: The compass points toward a location envisioned by its holder or the nearest portal leading there, with teleport-like accuracy. Once it locks onto a destination, it continues pointing there until arrival or planar travel changes the situation.

items/gloves-starry-sky-227.name: Gloves of the Starry Sky
items/gloves-starry-sky-227.effectSummary: The gloves emit light that can be toggled with a mental standard action. Three times per day, the wearer can sacrifice a prepared spell or spell slot of 1st level or higher to cast magic missile using their own caster level.

items/ice-necklace-of-the-ulutiun.name: Ice Necklace of the Ulutiun
items/ice-necklace-of-the-ulutiun.effectSummary: The necklace has six throwable crystals with an 80-foot range: four transparent crystals create ice storm and two opaque crystals create sleet storm at the point of impact.

items/eyes-of-doom.name: Eyes of Doom
items/eyes-of-doom.effectSummary: The lenses let the wearer target one creature per round with doom by gaze (Will DC 11; DC 10 with one lens). Wearing both also grants continual deathwatch and allows eyebite once per week (DC 19).

items/jumping-caltrops-417.name: Jumping Caltrops
items/jumping-caltrops-417.effectSummary: For 5 rounds after activation, the caltrops move 5 feet at the start of the user's turn toward the nearest enemy if their square is empty, then attack occupants as normal caltrops. Afterward they remain ordinary caltrops until the next dawn.

items/starmantle-cloak-432.name: Starmantle Cloak
items/starmantle-cloak-432.effectSummary: The cloak sheds torchlike light, destroys nonmagical weapons or missiles that strike the wearer, and makes the wearer immune to their attacks. Against magic weapons or missiles, a DC 15 Reflex save reduces damage by half.

items/thurible-of-warding.name: Thurible of Warding
items/thurible-of-warding.effectSummary: When lit, the thurible produces prayer and grants spell-like effects: three/day entropic shield, endure elements, or sanctuary; one/day silence or dispel magic; one/week spell immunity or spell resistance; one/month blade barrier.

items/catstink-343.name: Catstink
items/catstink-343.effectSummary: Sprinkling catstink on a trail is a standard action that provokes and confounds scent tracking for 10 minutes. A scent tracker must make Survival DC 15 or lose the trail; attempts to relocate it use the normal rules with +2 DC.

items/necklace-of-demons.name: Necklace of Demons
items/necklace-of-demons.effectSummary: The necklace carries eight removable spheres; breaking one on a hard surface summons demons for 10 rounds: two spheres summon 2d4 dretches, two summon a quasit, one a succubus, two a vrock, and one a hezrou.

items/crystal-sphere-of-singing-waters.name: Crystal Sphere of Singing Waters
items/crystal-sphere-of-singing-waters.effectSummary: Pouring holy water over the sphere activates it for 24 hours. While active it can produce faerie fire and purify food and drink at will, and once per day each can use neutralize poison and scrying, using the sphere as the scrying device.

items/stunning-spike.name: Stunning Spike
items/stunning-spike.effectSummary: Planting the spike is a standard action; one round later it becomes invisible. The first creature to come within 10 feet causes a 20-foot burst that stuns creatures for 1 round (Will DC 20 negates), destroying the spike.

items/sun-flash-pellet.name: Sun Flash Pellet
items/sun-flash-pellet.effectSummary: Thrown as a standard action, the pellet shatters on impact and creates a sunburst effect, making it particularly effective against creatures vulnerable to sunlight.

items/electric-eel-elixir-387.name: Electric Eel Elixir
items/electric-eel-elixir-387.effectSummary: For 12 hours, the elixir grants +1 enhancement to natural armor. Once during that duration, the user can make a melee touch attack for 1d8+1 electricity damage, with +3 circumstance on the attack roll against a target in metal armor.

items/pearl-of-the-sirines.name: Pearl of the Sirines
items/pearl-of-the-sirines.effectSummary: While holding the pearl appropriately, the possessor can breathe underwater as easily as air, gains swim speed 60 feet, and can cast spells and otherwise act underwater without hindrance.

items/portable-shade.name: Portable Shade
items/portable-shade.effectSummary: When unfolded, the silk disk floats over the user and automatically blocks direct sun while following them at up to 30 feet per round, granting parasol-like shade without occupying the hands. Folding it up as a move action ends the effect.

items/cape-of-the-wastes.name: Cape of the Wastes
items/cape-of-the-wastes.effectSummary: The cape protects the wearer from natural heat up through extreme heat, provides endure-elements-like protection from natural cold, and grants the benefit of the Sand Camouflage feat.

items/mothers-corset.name: Mother's Corset
items/mothers-corset.effectSummary: For up to 20 minutes per day, divisible as desired, the corset sprouts eight spider legs, granting climb speed 30 feet, +8 on Climb checks, and the ability to take 10 on Climb checks even when rushed or threatened.

items/eyes-of-the-eagle.name: Eyes of the Eagle
items/eyes-of-the-eagle.effectSummary: Wearing both lenses grants +5 circumstance on Spot checks. Wearing only one initially stuns the wearer for 1 round from dizziness; afterward it can be used alone if the other eye is covered.

items/fanged-mask.name: Fanged Mask
items/fanged-mask.effectSummary: The mask acts as a +1 weapon and grants a bite attack dealing 1d4 damage; a creature bitten must make Fortitude DC 13 or be stunned for 1 round. It does not add to an existing bite's damage.

items/hand-of-glory.name: Hand of Glory
items/hand-of-glory.effectSummary: A magic ring placed on the hand benefits the wearer without counting against the normal two-ring limit; the hand can hold one ring. Independently, it lets the wearer use daylight and see invisibility each once per day.

items/chaos-diamond-272.name: Chaos Diamond
items/chaos-diamond-272.effectSummary: The diamond grants confusion, lesser magic circle against law, word of chaos, and cloak of chaos, each usable 1d4 times per day. A nonchaotic possessor gains one persistent negative level while carrying it.

items/elixir-adamantine-blood-388.name: Elixir of Adamantine Blood
items/elixir-adamantine-blood-388.effectSummary: The elixir grants 10 temporary hit points for up to 1 hour, or 20 if drunk while wearing adamantine armor. If that armor is removed before the duration ends, 10 of those temporary hit points are immediately lost; these temporary hit points do not stack with other sources.
